info.title: Durianpay Legacy API
info.description: Durianpay legacy (orders/payments) API. Authentication: HTTP Basic — your Durianpay API key as the username with a blank password (Authorization: Basic base64(api_key + ':')). Set DURIANPAY_API_KEY.

basicAuth.description: HTTP Basic: Durianpay API key as username, blank password (Authorization: Basic base64(api_key + ':'))

x-auth-vars.name: DURIANPAY_API_KEY
x-auth-vars.description: Durianpay API key from Dashboard > Settings > API Keys (sandbox keys start dp_test_, live dp_live_). Sent as the Basic-auth username.

x-auth-vars.name: DURIANPAY_API_PASSWORD
x-auth-vars.description: Basic-auth password — leave unset; Durianpay uses a blank password.

post.description: The following endpoint creates an Order

amount.description: The amount for which the Order was created. Example: "10000" or "10000.23" for amount with decimal value

currency.description: The currency associated with the Order's amount. Example: "IDR"

customer.description: The customer fields including id, email, mobile, first_name, given_name, address json object, customer_ref_id. One of id, mobile, email is mandatory field whereas others are optional.  address is mandatory to use BNPL payment method.

email.description: The customer's email address. Should of the format redacted@example.com and should not contain any invalid special characters (¢,£,§,©,etc)

mobile.description: The customer's mobile number. Please ensure that the number follows Indonesia's phone number format : +62xxxxxxxxxx or 08xxxxxxxxxx.

customer_ref_id.description: A unique reference ID from the merchant to identify the customer

address.description: The address fields includes receiver_name, receiver_phone, label, address_line, city, region, postal_code, landmark

payment_option.description: The type of payment option with which order was created. Possible values: "full_payment" or "installment"

order_ref_id.description: The unique identifier of Order from the merchant. Example: "INV/1/2021"

items.description: Array of objects with each object including name, brand, category, sku, price, qty, total_price. mandatory to use BNPL and LINKAJA payment method

price.description: The price for a single item

logo.description: The URL for the logo of the item

sku.description: The SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) of the item

total_price.description: The total price of the item

description.description: String to store description of the order. Example: "This order is delicate. Handle with Care!"
description.default: This order is delicate handle with care

admin_fee_method.description: Used to specify if the transactional charges are to be included and paid by the merchant or customer. Possible Values:  "included" - Transaction Fee is paid by merchant "excluded" - Transaction Fee is paid by customer

metadata.description: Key-Value pair that can be used to store additional information about the entity.

expiry_date.description: The time stamp at which the order will expire. Please ensure that the value is in RFC3339 format and the timezone is in GMT+7. Example: "2022-03-29T10:00:00.000Z"

is_payment_link.description: Whether Payment Link is to be generated. Example: true or false

post.description: The following endpoint creates a new virtual account

bank_code.description: The bank code for the Virtual Account. Supported Bank Codes: "BRI", "BCA", "MANDIRI", "PERMATA", "CIMB", "BNI", "NOBU"

name.description: The name of the virtual account which will appear in ATM/Banking app. Example: "John's Virtual Account"

is_closed.description: Whether account can accept open(any amount) or closed(specific amount). Example: true or false

amount.description: Specify amount to be paid to va when is_closed=true. Example: "12000.12"

customer.description: Object containing fields (id, email, mobile, given_name). One of (id, mobile, email) is mandatory field and given_name is mandatory.

mobile.description: Customer's mobile number in Indonesia's phone number format (+62xxxxxxxxxx or 08xxxxxxxxxx), with a length of 8 to 14 digits.

email.description: Customer's email address in a valid email format (e.g., redacted@example.com) without invalid special characters (¢, £, §, ©, etc.)

customer_ref_id.description: A unique reference ID from the merchant to identify the customer

expiry_minutes.description: Number of minutes left till expiry from now. maximum: 15768000 minutes

account_suffix.description: Account suffix for the Virtual Account. If not provided, a random suffix will be automatically generated for the virtual account number.

is_reusable.description: Whether multiple payments can be used for a particular VA. Example: true or false

va_ref_id.description: A reference ID which the merchant wants to use for a specific VA. Example: "VA_XYZ_1234"

auto_disable_after_payment.description: Disable a reusable VA temporarily after a payment. Patch API can be used to enable it again after changing some parameters. Example: true or false

post.description: This following endpoint allows master accounts to manage fees for subaccounts

id.description: Unique identifier of the subaccount, which can be taken from the response of Register subaccount API or Fetch Subaccount API

payment_fees.description: Details on which payment method will be assigned with the fee, including the fee configuration. Either fixed_fee or percentage_fee is mandatory; you must provide one of them, but providing both is not required, If both fee presents, The fee is calculated by accumulating percentage fee (applied to the total amount before the fee) to the fixed fee.

payment_method_id.description: Payment method which will be updated with the new fee. Possible values: BCA, BNI For the complete list of the supported payment methods and its payment_method_id (code) please refer here: Supported Payment Method

fixed_fee.description: Amount of the fixed fee. Example: "1000"

percentage_fee.description: Amount of the percentage fee. Example: "10"

disbursement_fees.description: Details on the configuration of disbursement fees.

type.description: Fee type, possible values: flat, percentage

value.message: Merchant Fee has been updated successfully
